text: Why choose to study this program? International Finance is the branch of economics that studies the dynamics of exchange rates, foreign investment, and how these affect international trade. It also studies international projects, international investments and capital flows, and trade deficits. It includes the study of futures, options and currency swaps. All courses instruction and discussions of contemporary business issues are done in English, drawing on the vast knowledge and experience of the international faculty. The program also offers unique combination of subjects, addressing contemporary Chinese business concerns, Chinese culture, Asian values and advanced Western and American business practice and management. Students are encouraged to develop themselves into responsible, ethical business leaders who solve contentious corporate issues with a strong practical and theoretical grounding and cultural sensitivity. Main Courses International Finance,China Financial Systems,Financial Markets and Institutions,International Investment Analysis,M&A and Investment Banking,Commercial Banking,Private Equity and Venture Capital,Financial Reporting and Analysis Program Objectives The aim is to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. To graduate, a student must successfully earn the required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total, including those from internships and an optional applied research project. The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to:ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society;ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions;enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork. Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, visits to companies, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, and career consultation.The graduates of this program can work in the International trade transportation, insurance, customs clearance etc agencies, specialized foreign-trade corporations, and import and export department's of foreign-owned enterprises. Degree Awarded After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) . First year student Scholarship To qualify for a scholarship for the academic year, the student must meet the minimum academic qualifications and demonstrate sufficient funds for non-tuition fees including cost of living, personal expenses, travel expenses, books, ect. It is expected that each student should be able to contribute toward their tuition costs as very few full-tuition scholarships are granted.
